cosmetic.theme-jade.name: Jade
cosmetic.theme-violet.name: Violet

dailyModifier.blizzard.desc: Whiteout conditions. Frozen ore yields 20% less.
dailyModifier.bounty.desc: Every enemy unit destroyed pays $100, every structure $300.
dailyModifier.clear-skies.desc: No fog of war. Both sides see everything.
dailyModifier.credits-rain.desc: +$400 every 30 seconds and crates fall from the sky.
dailyModifier.double-ore.desc: Ore fields are twice as rich for everyone.
dailyModifier.fanatics.desc: Enemy factories run 35% faster and harvest 20% more.
dailyModifier.fast-production.desc: Factories everywhere run at double speed.
dailyModifier.glass-cannons.desc: All units fight at 60% of their normal health.
dailyModifier.night-ops.desc: Eternal midnight. Fight by floodlight and muzzle flash.
dailyModifier.no-radar.desc: Radar Domes are banned, and with them all high technology.
dailyModifier.pillbox-line.desc: Pillboxes are the only static defence you may build.
dailyModifier.sandstorm.desc: Choking dust storms. Ore trucks return 15% lighter.
dailyModifier.storm-front.desc: A thunderstorm rolls across the battlefield.
dailyModifier.tesla-only.desc: Tesla Coils are the only static defence you may build.
dailyModifier.veteran-start.desc: Every unit you field arrives as a Veteran.
doctrine.armouredfist.blurb: Steel first. Heavy columns that shrug off fire, Mammoths rolling off the line.
doctrine.armouredfist.name: Armoured Fist
doctrine.blitzkrieg.blurb: Speed is armour. Strike before the enemy can dig in.
doctrine.blitzkrieg.name: Blitzkrieg
doctrine.fortress.blurb: Hold the line. Every approach covered, every wall cheap.
doctrine.fortress.name: Fortress Europe
doctrine.humanwave.blurb: Quantity has a quality all its own. The barracks never stop.
doctrine.humanwave.name: Human Wave
doctrine.ironrain.blurb: Death from above and beyond: V2 batteries and air wings that never rest.
doctrine.ironrain.bonuses.0: V2 Rocket Launchers reach 25% further and have 30% more health
doctrine.ironrain.name: Iron Rain
doctrine.precision.blurb: Find them, fix them, finish them from a distance.
doctrine.precision.bonuses.0: Artillery, Longbows and Cruisers deal 20% more damage
doctrine.precision.name: Precision Strike
doctrine.shadow.blurb: The war is won before the first shot: spies everywhere, fields of shroud.
doctrine.shadow.bonuses.0: Spies, Thieves, Gap Generators and Radar Jammers cost 40% less; gap shroud reaches 40% further
doctrine.shadow.bonuses.1: Earn 20% more command points; Recon Sweep and Sabotage recharge 40% faster
doctrine.shadow.name: Shadow Network
doctrine.tesla.blurb: Volkov's favourite toys: coils, tanks and troopers that hit like lightning.
doctrine.tesla.name: Tesla Doctrine
map.archipelago.desc: Two home islands in open sea. A chain of islets, sandbars and a bridge leads to the gem island; the sea decides the rest.
map.archipelago.name: Archipelago
map.bridgewater.desc: A broad river splits the valley. Hold the two bridges and the shallow ford in the middle to control the crossing.
map.bridgewater.name: Bridgewater
map.coastline.desc: A peninsula wrapped in sea, quartered by rivers that drain into a central lagoon. Bridges and fords link the four corners.
map.coastline.name: Coastline
map.frozen-lakes.desc: Pine forests and frozen lakes funnel armies into three snowbound corridors. The middle one passes the gem field.
map.frozen-lakes.name: Frozen Lakes
map.inland-sea.desc: Four commanders ring a great inland sea. Every base has a harbour bay; bridged causeways lead to the gem isle at its heart.
map.inland-sea.name: Inland Sea
map.pocket-valley.desc: A small, fast map: a rocky ridge with three passes separates the bases. Rush or tech — the first push decides.
map.pocket-valley.name: Pocket Valley
map.proving-grounds.desc: Classic open-field duel: two ore fields at home, a contested gem pit in the middle and forests to flank through.
map.proving-grounds.name: Proving Grounds
map.red-canyon.desc: Towering mesas carve the desert into three lanes: a wide central wash and two narrow canyons rich with ore.
map.red-canyon.name: Red Canyon
map.three-kingdoms.desc: Three realms separated by broken ridges meet at a gem crater. Every pass is a choke point; every neighbour a threat.
map.three-kingdoms.name: Three Kingdoms

modExample.glass-cannon.description: Short, brutal battles: every unit has 60% of its normal health and every weapon deals 30% more damage. Structures keep their full strength.
modExample.glass-cannon.name: Glass Cannon
modExample.tank-rush.description: Armour rolls off the line cheaper and faster: every tank costs 25% less and drives 25% faster, War Factories are cheaper, and the Soviets get the Rhino, a lighter and quicker Heavy Tank built for the rush.
modExample.tank-rush.name: Tank Rush
mutator.big-guns.name: Big Guns
mutator.blizzard.desc: Whiteout conditions. Frozen ore yields 20% less.
mutator.blizzard.name: Blizzard
mutator.bounty.desc: Every enemy unit destroyed pays $100, every structure $300, to whoever destroys it.
mutator.bounty.name: Bounty Hunter
mutator.clear-skies.desc: No fog of war. Both sides see everything.
mutator.clear-skies.name: Clear Skies
mutator.credits-rain.desc: +$400 for every commander every 30 seconds, and crates fall from the sky.
mutator.credits-rain.name: Supply Drops
mutator.double-ore.desc: Ore fields are twice as rich for everyone.
mutator.double-ore.name: Mother Lode
mutator.fanatics.desc: AI factories run 35% faster and their harvesters bring in 20% more.
mutator.fanatics.name: Fanatics
mutator.fast-production.desc: Factories everywhere run at double speed.
mutator.fast-production.name: War Economy
mutator.fog-plus.desc: Every unit and structure sees 35% less. Scout or be ambushed.
mutator.fog-plus.name: Fog of War+
mutator.glass-base.desc: Every structure has half its normal health.
mutator.glass-base.name: Glass Base
mutator.glass-cannons.desc: Every unit has 60% of its normal health: battles are short and brutal.
mutator.glass-cannons.name: Glass Cannons
mutator.golden-ore.desc: Ore is worth three times as much. Expect huge armies.
mutator.golden-ore.name: Golden Ore
mutator.heavy-metal.desc: Mammoth Tanks for both sides, straight from the War Factory.
mutator.heavy-metal.name: Heavy Metal
mutator.lean-times.name: Lean Times
mutator.lightning-war.desc: Everything builds twice as fast, and superweapons and support powers charge twice as fast.
mutator.lightning-war.name: Lightning War
mutator.mega-crates.desc: Crates drop every 20 seconds: money crates pay double and unit crates bring two.
mutator.mega-crates.name: Mega Crates
mutator.night-ops.desc: Eternal midnight. Fight by floodlight and muzzle flash.
mutator.night-ops.name: Night Ops
mutator.no-radar.desc: Radar Domes are banned for everyone, and with them all high technology.
mutator.no-radar.name: Radar Blackout
mutator.pillbox-line.desc: Pillboxes are the only ground defence anyone may build (anti-air sites still allowed).
mutator.pillbox-line.name: Pillbox Line
mutator.sandstorm.desc: Choking dust storms. Ore trucks return 15% lighter.
mutator.sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
mutator.storm-front.desc: A thunderstorm rolls across the battlefield.
mutator.storm-front.name: Storm Front
mutator.tank-rush.desc: Light, medium, heavy, Mammoth and Tesla tanks cost 40% less.
mutator.tank-rush.name: Tank Rush
mutator.tesla-only.desc: Tesla Coils are the only ground defence anyone may build (anti-air sites still allowed).
mutator.tesla-only.name: Tesla Doctrine
mutator.veteran-start.desc: Every unit fielded, on every side, arrives as a Veteran.
mutator.veteran-start.name: Veteran Corps
netmode.1v1.name: 1 vs 1
netmode.2v2.desc: Two teams of two; any seat can be an AI.
netmode.2v2.name: 2 vs 2
netmode.coop.desc: Players team up against AI commanders.
netmode.coop.name: Co-op vs AI
netmode.ffa.desc: Up to four commanders, every one for himself.
netmode.ffa.name: Free for all
personality.admiral.blurb: Rules the waves: an early shipyard, a big fleet, coastal raids and shore bombardment.
personality.admiral.name: Naval Raider
personality.airmarshal.blurb: Owns the sky: helipads and airfields early, strike after strike on harvesters and defences.
personality.airmarshal.name: Air Marshal
personality.balanced.blurb: Reads the battlefield and answers it: a sound economy, a mixed army, attacks when ready.
personality.balanced.name: Balanced Professor
personality.guerrilla.blurb: Never where you expect: fast raiders hit your harvesters and vanish before you can respond.
personality.guerrilla.name: Guerrilla Harasser
personality.horde.blurb: Endless infantry: rifles, rockets, grenades and flamethrowers by the hundred.
personality.horde.name: Human Wave
personality.ironfist.blurb: Heavy armour and nothing but: slow, crushing columns of the best tanks money can buy.
personality.ironfist.name: Iron Fist
personality.rusher.blurb: War factory first, tanks early and often. Hits before your defences are up.
personality.rusher.name: Armour Rusher
personality.saboteur.blurb: Spies in your power plants, mines on your roads, thieves in your silos and bombs from the sky.
personality.saboteur.name: Saboteur
personality.siege.blurb: Patient and methodical: artillery parks and V2 batteries grind your base down from range.
personality.siege.name: Siege Master
personality.turtle.blurb: Fortifies every approach, techs up behind the guns and comes out late with overwhelming force.
personality.turtle.name: Tesla Turtle
personality.tycoon.blurb: Grabs every ore field on the map, then buries you under a mountain of money.
personality.tycoon.name: Tycoon
power.aegis.desc: Your units in the area take half damage for 15 s.
power.aegis.name: Aegis Shield
power.barrage.desc: After a 3 s warning that the enemy sees too, 14 shells rain on the area.
power.barrage.name: Artillery Barrage
power.elite.desc: Your next 4 combat units arrive as Veterans.
power.elite.name: Elite Training
power.funds.desc: An immediate $1,000 from High Command (more when you are behind, less when far ahead).
power.funds.name: Emergency Funds
power.rally.desc: Your units in the area move 30% faster and fire 33% faster for 20 s.
power.rally.name: Rally Cry
power.recon.desc: Reveals the target area for 25 s.
power.recon.name: Recon Sweep
power.reinforce.desc: A tank column rolls in from the map edge behind your base and heads for the target.
power.reinforce.name: Reinforcements
power.repair.desc: Repairs 45% of the health of your units in the area, and 20% of your structures.
power.repair.name: Field Repair
power.sabotage.desc: Cuts the power at an enemy structure for 40 s: a power plant stops generating, a defence goes silent.
power.sabotage.name: Sabotage
power.storm.desc: After a 2 s warning, 10 lightning strikes hit enemies in the area.
power.storm.name: Tesla Storm
research.chrono_logistics.blurb: Einstein's gift to the supply corps.
research.chrono_logistics.levels.0.effec: Full Ore Trucks far from a refinery chronoshift next to it (each once every 45 s).
research.chrono_logistics.levels.1.effec: The Chronosphere and Chrono Tanks recharge 30% faster.
research.chrono_logistics.name: Chrono Logistics
research.composite_armor.blurb: Layered ceramic plates turn shells aside.
research.composite_armor.name: Composite Armour
research.conscription.blurb: Every factory worker knows which end of a rifle to hold.
research.conscription.levels.1.effect: Infantry cost 25% less and train 25% faster.
research.conscription.name: Conscription
research.field_medicine.blurb: Medics and mechanics in every squad.
research.field_medicine.levels.0.effect: Infantry heal 1.5% of their health per second when out of combat for 8 s.
research.field_medicine.levels.1.effect: Vehicles heal 1% per second out of combat too.
research.field_medicine.name: Field Medicine
research.heavy_industry.levels.1.effect: Vehicles cost 15% less and build 15% faster.
research.heavy_industry.name: Heavy Industry
research.improved_harvesters.levels.0.ef: Ore Trucks carry 25% more and take 25% less damage.
research.improved_harvesters.name: Improved Harvesters
research.precision_optics.levels.0.effec: Vehicle and defence weapons reach 6% further.
research.precision_optics.levels.1.effec: Vehicle and defence weapons reach 12% further.
research.precision_optics.name: Precision Optics
research.rapid_deployment.levels.1.effec: Structures, upgrades and research also build 25% faster.
research.rapid_deployment.name: Rapid Deployment
research.reactive_armor.blurb: Explosive bricks that meet the shell halfway.
research.reactive_armor.levels.0.effect: Heavy, Mammoth, Tesla and M.A.D. Tanks +15% health.
research.reactive_armor.levels.1.effect: Heavy, Mammoth, Tesla and M.A.D. Tanks +30% health.
research.reactive_armor.name: Reactive Armour
research.tesla_amplifiers.blurb: More coils, more current, more screaming.
research.tesla_amplifiers.levels.1.effec: Tesla Coils reach 15% further and drain 40% less power.
research.tesla_amplifiers.name: Tesla Amplifiers
techTier.1.name: Foundation
techTier.2.name: Industrial
techTier.3.name: Command
unit.1tnk.name: Light Tank
unit.2tnk.name: Medium Tank
unit.3tnk.name: Heavy Tank
unit.4tnk.description: Massive twin-cannon tank with missile pods. Self-repairs.
unit.4tnk.name: Mammoth Tank
unit.apc.description: Armoured personnel carrier. Transports up to five infantry.
unit.apc.name: APC
unit.arty.name: Artillery
unit.badr.description: Soviet bomber: drops paratroopers or parabombs.
unit.badr.name: Badger
unit.ca.description: Heavy warship. Twin 8-inch guns bombard targets far inland. Cannot engage submarines.
unit.ca.name: Cruiser
unit.ctnk.description: Anti-armour missile tank that can chronoshift itself anywhere you have explored (recharges).
unit.ctnk.name: Chrono Tank
unit.dd.description: Escort ship. Missiles hit ships, ground and aircraft; depth charges hunt submarines.
unit.dd.name: Destroyer
unit.dog.description: Fast scout that lunges at enemy infantry.
unit.dog.name: Attack Dog
unit.dtrk.description: Truck loaded with a nuclear charge: order it to attack and it drives in and detonates. Explodes if destroyed.
unit.dtrk.name: Demolition Truck
unit.e1.description: Cheap, versatile foot soldier. Strong against infantry.
unit.e1.name: Rifle Infantry
unit.e2.description: Lobs grenades over obstacles. Good against infantry and structures.
unit.e2.name: Grenadier
unit.e3.name: Rocket Soldier
unit.e4.description: Incinerates infantry and wooden structures at close range.
unit.e4.name: Flamethrower
unit.e6.description: Captures heavily damaged enemy structures, repairs friendly ones.
unit.e6.name: Engineer
unit.e7.description: Commando. Deadly against infantry; demolishes structures with C4.
unit.e7.name: Tanya
unit.harv.description: Harvests ore and gems and delivers them to a refinery.
unit.harv.name: Ore Truck
unit.heli.description: Attack helicopter armed with Hellfire missiles.
unit.heli.name: Longbow
unit.hind.description: Assault helicopter with a chain gun.
unit.hind.name: Hind
unit.jeep.description: Fast scout car with a machine gun turret.
unit.jeep.name: Ranger
unit.lst.description: Landing craft. Carries five infantry or vehicles; beach it next to land to load and unload.
unit.lst.name: Transport
unit.mcv.name: Mobile Construction Vehicle
unit.mech.description: Field mechanic: repairs nearby damaged vehicles.
unit.mech.name: Mechanic
unit.medi.name: Field Medic
unit.mgg.description: Shrouds the area around it from enemy eyes and radar.
unit.mgg.name: Mobile Gap Generator
unit.mig.description: Strike jet armed with Maverick missiles.
unit.mig.name: MiG
unit.mnly.description: Lays five hidden mines (Allied anti-tank, Soviet anti-personnel). Re-arms at a Service Depot.
unit.mnly.name: Minelayer
unit.mrj.description: Jams enemy radar domes and SAM sites within range.
unit.mrj.name: Mobile Radar Jammer
unit.msub.description: Submarine with long-range missiles for ships and shore targets. Surfaces to fire.
unit.msub.name: Missile Submarine
unit.pt.description: Fast patrol boat with a deck gun and depth charges. Detects submarines nearby.
unit.pt.name: Gunboat
unit.qtnk.description: Deploy (D) to charge a seismic shock that wrecks every vehicle and structure nearby (friend or foe). The crew bails out; the tank is lost.
unit.qtnk.name: M.A.D. Tank
unit.rhino.description: Lighter, faster variant of the Heavy Tank. Trades armour for tempo.
unit.rhino.name: Rhino Tank
unit.shok.description: Elite infantry with a portable Tesla coil. Strong against infantry and vehicles.
unit.shok.name: Shock Trooper
unit.spy.description: Disguised as an enemy soldier; only dogs see through it. Infiltrates structures: radar, power, money and factory intel, sonar from a sub pen.
unit.spy.name: Spy
unit.ss.description: Stealthy attack submarine. Surfaces only to fire torpedoes at ships.
unit.ss.name: Submarine
unit.stnk.description: Cloaked armoured transport for five infantry. Visible only while firing or with an enemy right next to it.
unit.stnk.name: Phase Transport
unit.thf.description: Sneaks into an enemy refinery or silo and steals half of their credits.
unit.thf.name: Thief
unit.tran.description: Transport helicopter. Carries five infantry; lands to load and unload.
unit.tran.name: Chinook
unit.truk.description: Neutral supply convoy. Escort it across the map (right-click it) or force-fire it (Ctrl + right-click) to seize its cargo.
unit.truk.name: Supply Truck
unit.ttnk.description: Tank with a mounted Tesla coil. Its coil also jams enemy radar nearby.
unit.ttnk.name: Tesla Tank
unit.u2.name: Spy Plane
unit.v2rl.name: V2 Rocket Launcher
unit.yak.name: Yak
upgrade.barr_training.blurb: Live-fire drills: recruits leave the gate already blooded.
upgrade.barr_training.effect: Infantry trained here arrive as Veterans.
upgrade.barr_training.name: Training Ground
upgrade.cy_t2.blurb: Cranes, extra bays and a bigger crew: the yard can build industrial and advanced structures.
upgrade.cy_t2.effect: Unlocks the Research Lab, Logistics Centre, Ore Purifier, Fortress Gate, Tech Centre and Tier 2 upgrades.
upgrade.cy_t2.name: Tier 2: Industrial
upgrade.cy_t3.blurb: A command tower crowns the yard: the war's most advanced projects are now within reach.
upgrade.cy_t3.effect: Unlocks superweapons, Level II research and the Armour Shop.
upgrade.cy_t3.name: Tier 3: Command
upgrade.def_reinforced.name: Reinforced
upgrade.dome_uplink.blurb: A dish on the dome, a direct line to orbit.
upgrade.dome_uplink.effect: The dome sees 6 cells further, and support powers (GPS, spy plane, paratroopers, parabombs) recharge 25% faster.
upgrade.dome_uplink.name: Satellite Uplink
upgrade.powr_turbine.blurb: More power without more plants to guard.
upgrade.powr_turbine.name: Turbine
upgrade.proc_processor.blurb: A second processing line: the queue at the dock shrinks, the money grows.
upgrade.proc_processor.effect: Ore unloaded here is worth 20% more, and trucks unload twice as fast.
upgrade.proc_processor.name: Ore Processor
upgrade.weap_armor.blurb: Every hull gets extra plates bolted on.
upgrade.weap_armor.effect: All your vehicles +10% health while you keep it.
upgrade.weap_armor.name: Armour Shop
upgrade.weap_assembly.blurb: A second line runs night and day.
upgrade.weap_assembly.effect: All vehicles build 25% faster (one Assembly Line is enough).
upgrade.weap_assembly.name: Assembly Line
worldHomeland.afghanistan.blurb: Mountain passes that empires break their teeth on. The best defence in the world, and the slowest way out of it.
worldHomeland.afghanistan.name: Afghanistan
worldHomeland.algeria.blurb: A white city on the sea with the whole Sahara behind it. North Africa is yours to unite.
worldHomeland.algeria.name: Algeria
worldHomeland.arabia.blurb: Sand seas around a kingdom of oil and oases. Few neighbours can reach you, and you can reach three seas.
worldHomeland.arabia.name: Arabia
worldHomeland.argentina.blurb: The pampas and their endless herds, from the River Plate to the ice of Patagonia. The south of the world is yours.
worldHomeland.argentina.name: Argentina
worldHomeland.australia.blurb: An island continent at the end of the world. Unite it quietly, then island-hop north into Asia.
worldHomeland.australia.name: Australia
worldHomeland.brazil.blurb: Half a continent of jungle, rivers and harbours, and the shortest crossing to Africa. Room to grow, and then some.
worldHomeland.brazil.name: Brazil
worldHomeland.britain.blurb: An island fortress with the Channel for a moat and the Royal Navy at the door. Hold the sea lanes and strike where you please.
worldHomeland.britain.name: Britain
worldHomeland.canada.blurb: Forest, lakes and tundra to the Arctic Ocean. A huge, quiet start with the Atlantic convoys at hand.
worldHomeland.canada.name: Canada
worldHomeland.chile.blurb: A thin strip between the Andes and the Pacific, with copper in the mountains. The mountains guard your back.
worldHomeland.chile.name: Chile
worldHomeland.china.blurb: Endless manpower from the Great Wall to the Yangtze. Hold East Asia and no rival can match your reinforcements.
worldHomeland.china.name: China
worldHomeland.congo.blurb: The great river and the rainforest at the heart of Africa, with copper and uranium under the green.
worldHomeland.congo.name: Congo
worldHomeland.cuba.blurb: The key to the Caribbean, ninety miles from the mainland. Small, but every lane in the Gulf runs past you.
worldHomeland.cuba.name: Cuba
worldHomeland.egypt.blurb: The Nile, the pyramids and the road between Africa and Asia. Every army in history has wanted Cairo.
worldHomeland.egypt.name: Egypt
worldHomeland.ethiopia.blurb: An ancient empire on a mountain plateau that no invader has kept. Look down on Africa and Arabia alike.
worldHomeland.ethiopia.name: Ethiopia
worldHomeland.france.blurb: The crossroads of Western Europe, with roads to every border and a coast on two seas. Everyone is a neighbour.
worldHomeland.france.name: France
worldHomeland.germany.blurb: The industrial heart of Europe, ringed by rivals on every side. Fast hands win here; slow ones are surrounded.
worldHomeland.germany.name: Germany
worldHomeland.greece.blurb: Mountains, islands and a fleet's worth of harbours where Europe meets the Levant. A small start with long reach.
worldHomeland.greece.name: Greece
worldHomeland.iceland.blurb: A volcanic rock alone in the North Atlantic, with the convoy lanes of two continents at its door. The hardest start of all.
worldHomeland.iceland.name: Iceland
worldHomeland.india.blurb: A subcontinent of millions behind the Himalaya, with the Indian Ocean as its front yard. Grow first, then strike.
worldHomeland.india.name: India
worldHomeland.indonesia.blurb: Thousands of islands on the oil route between two oceans. Rule the straits and the trade of half the world is yours.
worldHomeland.indonesia.name: Indonesia
worldHomeland.iran.blurb: Oil fields, mountain walls and the Gulf at your feet. Every road between Arabia and Turkestan runs through you.
worldHomeland.iran.name: Iran
worldHomeland.ireland.blurb: One green island on the Atlantic rim: small, hard to reach and nobody's first target. Start quiet, finish loud.
worldHomeland.ireland.name: Ireland
worldHomeland.italy.blurb: A long peninsula reaching into the middle of the Mediterranean. Ports everywhere, and the Alps at your back.
worldHomeland.italy.name: Italy
worldHomeland.japan.blurb: Island factories and harbours off the coast of Asia. The sea keeps you safe until you are ready to cross it.
worldHomeland.japan.name: Japan
worldHomeland.low-countries.blurb: Dykes, ports and canals between the great powers. Rich, flat and in everyone's way: strike first.
worldHomeland.low-countries.name: Low Countries
worldHomeland.mexico.blurb: Volcanoes, oil and the bridge between the two Americas. North or south: the choice is yours.
worldHomeland.mexico.name: Mexico
worldHomeland.mongolia.blurb: The steppe of the old horse empires, between Siberia and China. Nothing between you and the horizon but grass.
worldHomeland.mongolia.name: Mongolia
worldHomeland.morocco.blurb: Atlantic ports and Atlas peaks across the strait from Spain. Europe is a short crossing away.
worldHomeland.morocco.name: Morocco
worldHomeland.new-zealand.blurb: Two green islands at the far end of the Pacific. The last place anyone attacks, and the longest road to victory.
worldHomeland.new-zealand.name: New Zealand
worldHomeland.nigeria.blurb: The giant of West Africa, rich in people, with the Niger delta at its feet. The Atlantic road to the Americas starts next door.
worldHomeland.nigeria.name: Nigeria
worldHomeland.pakistan.blurb: The Indus and the port of Karachi, at the gate between the Middle East and India. Two worlds to choose from.
worldHomeland.pakistan.name: Pakistan
worldHomeland.peru.blurb: The old Inca heartland high in the Andes. Thin air, steep valleys and a fortress at every pass.
worldHomeland.peru.name: Peru
worldHomeland.philippines.blurb: Seven thousand islands on the edge of the Pacific, a short hop from Asia and a long one from everywhere else.
worldHomeland.philippines.name: Philippines
worldHomeland.poland.blurb: Open plains between Berlin and Moscow, with no mountain to hide behind. Survive the first turns and the map is yours.
worldHomeland.poland.name: Poland
worldHomeland.south-africa.blurb: Gold mines and the Cape of Good Hope, where two oceans meet. Far from every rival: build up in peace.
worldHomeland.south-africa.name: South Africa
worldHomeland.soviet-union.blurb: The largest country on Earth, with a long winter and a longer border. Deep reserves, and fronts in every direction.
worldHomeland.soviet-union.name: Soviet Union
worldHomeland.spain.blurb: A high plateau behind the Pyrenees, with Gibraltar's strait as the door to Africa. Easy to defend, slow to leave.
worldHomeland.spain.name: Spain
worldHomeland.sweden.blurb: Iron mines in the north, shipyards in the south and the Baltic all around. Neutral by habit, not by necessity.
worldHomeland.sweden.name: Sweden
worldHomeland.thailand.blurb: The rice bowl of Indochina, the one kingdom of the region no colonial empire ever took. Keep it that way, then take theirs.
worldHomeland.thailand.name: Thailand
worldHomeland.turkey.blurb: Keeper of the straits between the Black Sea and the Mediterranean, with a foot in Europe and one in Asia.
worldHomeland.turkey.name: Turkey
worldHomeland.ukraine.blurb: The black-earth breadbasket on the Black Sea, with grain enough to feed armies and steppe enough to lose them.
worldHomeland.ukraine.name: Ukraine
worldHomeland.usa.blurb: The arsenal of the free world between two oceans. Unmatched industry, and every enemy an ocean away.
worldHomeland.usa.name: United States
worldHomeland.venezuela.blurb: Oil on the Caribbean shore, at the top of South America. Panama and the islands are within reach.
worldHomeland.venezuela.name: Venezuela
worldHomeland.vietnam.blurb: Jungle, paddies and mountains made for a defender. Whoever comes for you comes the hard way.
worldHomeland.vietnam.name: Vietnam
worldLandmark.alhambra.blurb: The red fortress-palace of Granada, its courtyards of fountains under the snows of the Sierra Nevada.
worldLandmark.alhambra.name: Alhambra
worldLandmark.angkor-wat.blurb: The lotus towers of the Khmer kings, rising out of the jungle by the great lake.
worldLandmark.angkor-wat.name: Angkor Wat
worldLandmark.big-ben.blurb: The clock tower of Westminster. Treaties are signed to its chimes, and kept a little longer.
worldLandmark.big-ben.name: Big Ben
worldLandmark.brandenburg-gate.blurb: The great gate of Berlin, where every road and railway of Central Europe meets.
worldLandmark.brandenburg-gate.name: Brandenburg Gate
worldLandmark.chichen-itza.blurb: The stepped pyramid of the Maya, a stone calendar whose shadow marks the turn of every season.
worldLandmark.chichen-itza.name: Chichen Itza
worldLandmark.colosseum.blurb: The arena of the legions. Rome still raises soldiers in its shadow.
worldLandmark.colosseum.name: Colosseum
worldLandmark.dutch-windmills.blurb: The mills that pumped a country out of the sea and turned its polders into Europe's market garden.
worldLandmark.dutch-windmills.name: Windmills of Holland
worldLandmark.eiffel-tower.blurb: Iron lattice over the Seine, and a radio mast since the century began: its operators hear every army on the continent.
worldLandmark.eiffel-tower.name: Eiffel Tower
worldLandmark.empire-state.blurb: The tallest building in the world, over the busiest city in the world. Money never sleeps here.
worldLandmark.empire-state.name: Empire State Building
worldLandmark.forbidden-city.blurb: The emperors' palace at the heart of Peking, with its golden roofs and nine thousand rooms.
worldLandmark.forbidden-city.name: Forbidden City
worldLandmark.galata-tower.blurb: The old Genoese watchtower over the Golden Horn, keeping watch on the straits between two seas.
worldLandmark.galata-tower.name: Galata Tower
worldLandmark.gateway-of-india.blurb: The basalt arch on the Bombay waterfront, where the fleets of the Indian Ocean come ashore.
worldLandmark.gateway-of-india.name: Gateway of India
worldLandmark.golden-gate.blurb: The orange span across the Golden Gate, the door between San Francisco Bay and the Pacific.
worldLandmark.golden-gate.name: Golden Gate Bridge
worldLandmark.great-wall.blurb: Watchtowers on every ridge from the sea to the desert: the longest defence line ever built.
worldLandmark.great-wall.name: Great Wall of China
worldLandmark.harbour-bridge.blurb: The coat hanger over Sydney Harbour, the steel arch that ties the city together.
worldLandmark.harbour-bridge.name: Sydney Harbour Bridge
worldLandmark.himeji-castle.blurb: The White Heron castle, a maze of gates and walls that no army has ever taken.
worldLandmark.himeji-castle.name: Himeji Castle
worldLandmark.kilimanjaro.blurb: Snow on the equator: the roof of Africa looks out over the whole savanna.
worldLandmark.kilimanjaro.name: Mount Kilimanjaro
worldLandmark.leaning-tower.blurb: Galileo's bell tower, leaning for eight centuries and not falling yet. Fortune favours the stubborn.
worldLandmark.leaning-tower.name: Leaning Tower of Pisa
worldLandmark.machu-picchu.blurb: The lost Inca citadel on a ridge above the clouds, reached only by mountain paths.
worldLandmark.machu-picchu.name: Machu Picchu
worldLandmark.matterhorn.blurb: The pyramid peak of the Alps, above an alpine redoubt with a fortress in every mountain.
worldLandmark.matterhorn.name: Matterhorn
worldLandmark.mount-fuji.blurb: The snow-capped volcano over the plain of Tokyo, seen from a hundred kilometres out at sea.
worldLandmark.mount-fuji.name: Mount Fuji
worldLandmark.mount-rushmore.blurb: Four presidents carved into the granite of the Black Hills, staring down every army on the plains.
worldLandmark.mount-rushmore.name: Mount Rushmore
worldLandmark.neuschwanstein.blurb: A fairy-tale castle in the Bavarian Alps, built by a king who spent a fortune and left a treasury of visitors.
worldLandmark.neuschwanstein.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
worldLandmark.panama-locks.blurb: The locks that lift ships across a continent: whoever holds them holds the short way between two oceans.
worldLandmark.panama-locks.name: Panama Canal Locks
worldLandmark.parthenon.blurb: The temple on the Acropolis, the rock that Athens has defended since the age of bronze.
worldLandmark.parthenon.name: Parthenon
worldLandmark.persepolis.blurb: The ruined Gate of All Nations, where the envoys of the known world brought tribute to the Persian kings.
worldLandmark.persepolis.name: Persepolis
worldLandmark.petra.blurb: The rose-red city carved into the cliffs, once the toll gate of every caravan between Arabia and the sea.
worldLandmark.petra.name: Petra
worldLandmark.pyramids.blurb: Four and a half thousand years on the edge of the desert, and they have watched every army pass.
worldLandmark.pyramids.name: Pyramids of Giza
worldLandmark.registan.blurb: Three tiled madrasas around the square of Samarkand, at the crossroads of the Silk Road.
worldLandmark.registan.name: Registan
worldLandmark.st-basils.blurb: Onion domes over Red Square, where the parades march before they march west.
worldLandmark.st-basils.name: St Basil's Cathedral
worldLandmark.statue-of-liberty.blurb: Liberty Enlightening the World, raising her torch over New York Harbor from the Jersey shore.
worldLandmark.statue-of-liberty.name: Statue of Liberty
worldLandmark.sugarloaf.blurb: The granite dome over Guanabara Bay, with its cable car above the busiest harbour in South America.
worldLandmark.sugarloaf.name: Sugarloaf Mountain
worldLandmark.table-mountain.blurb: The flat-topped mountain over the Cape, the landmark of every ship between the Atlantic and the Indian Ocean.
worldLandmark.table-mountain.name: Table Mountain
worldLandmark.taj-mahal.blurb: The white marble tomb on the Yamuna, built by an emperor for love: rivals speak softly here.
worldLandmark.taj-mahal.name: Taj Mahal
worldLandmark.tower-bridge.blurb: The gateway to the Port of London: its bascules rise for a fleet bound anywhere in the world.
worldLandmark.tower-bridge.name: Tower Bridge
worldLandmark.victoria-falls.blurb: The smoke that thunders: the Zambezi falls a hundred metres into a gorge, with power enough for a nation.
worldLandmark.victoria-falls.name: Victoria Falls
worldLandmark.winter-palace.blurb: The tsars' palace on the Neva, in the city that held out through a nine-hundred-day siege.
worldLandmark.winter-palace.name: Winter Palace
